payload.title: alert-engine alert rules and escalation policies are readable by every tenant member and writable by any holder of the global MODULE_MANAGER account role, although rules evaluate only SensorReading, so a farm or HR manager can change sensor alarm thresholds, recipients and on-call schedules
evidence: apps/alert-engine/src/alert/resolvers/alert.resolver.ts:50 (alertRules, and alertRule at :39, carry no role decorator)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/resolvers/alert.resolver.ts:157 (createAlertRule, and updateAlertRule at :176, admit TENANT_ADMIN or MODULE_MANAGER)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/resolvers/escalation-policy.resolver.ts:82 (currentOnCallUser and the policy reads at :50-77 carry no role decorator)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/resolvers/escalation-policy.resolver.ts:98 (policy create, update, clone, suppression and on-call mutations admit any MODULE_MANAGER)
libs/backend-common/src/decorators/roles.decorator.ts:85 (MODULE_MANAGER is one tenant-wide account role, with no module attached)
payload.rule_violated: D4 and D2: rules evaluate only SensorReading, so writing them is a sensor-module operation, not a tenant-wide account-role operation.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-12, release R5.
